name: Cala Beach Resort
insider_take: Hidden on Tuscany's most exclusive peninsula, Cala Beach Resort is where Italian Riviera glamour meets unspoiled Maremma nature — effortlessly chic and refreshingly private.
whats_special: This Leading Hotels of the World member sits directly on the turquoise waters of Punta Ala, a gated coastal enclave in the Tuscan Maremma. The resort enjoys a rare beachfront position backed by fragrant Mediterranean pine forests, with sweeping views toward the island of Elba. Expect polished Italian hospitality, elegant rooms with sea-facing terraces, and a setting that feels a world away from the crowds.
pro_tip: Punta Ala has its own private marina — rent a small boat or join a sailing excursion to explore the Tuscan Archipelago, including the island of Elba, Giglio, and Giannutri, all easily reachable on a day trip.
dont_miss: Punta Ala is one of Italy's top windsurfing and sailing destinations — take advantage of the reliable Ponentino breeze straight off the Tyrrhenian Sea. On land, the nearby Diaccia Botrona nature reserve offers stunning coastal lagoon scenery, while the medieval hill town of Castiglione della Pescaia is just minutes away for an authentic Tuscan evening stroll.
pros: Prime beachfront location on Tuscany's stunning coastline
Elegant Mediterranean-style accommodations with sea views
Exceptional Italian cuisine and local Tuscan specialties
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive location
Seasonal resort with limited winter availability
